scenarios.oracle: Same identity and intent returns one immutable receipt and one stock decrement.
Different keys with equal commands produce two independent reservations.
Unique-key arbitration and a fresh statement snapshot return the winning receipt.
Concurrent reuse of a key with another quantity rejects the second intent.
Equal textual keys stay independent across trusted tenant contexts.
Two distinct keys contend for one unit; exactly one succeeds.
Failure after claim insertion commits no receipt and no stock change.
Failure after stock decrement rolls both tables back.
Proxy drops actual COMMIT acknowledgement; original-key reconciliation observes one effect.
An absent lookup while another attempt is active is not classified as aborted.
Native cancellation of a blocked query finalizes or retires the owned connection.
Canceled pool acquisition cannot orphan a late lease.
Repeated failures/cancellation in a size-one pool permit bounded subsequent success.
Runtime parsing rejects invalid shape/types/ranges before mutation and normalizes integral numbers.

notes: Numeric 1e0 is equivalent to 1.0 after JSON parsing.
NaN and infinities are invalid; parsers may reject them before domain validation.
